scope: Proposition 3.1 (Distributional local law) of the manuscript “Fixed-energy universality for weak Anderson disorder on random regular graphs” (preprints/Fixed-energy-universality-for-weak-Anderson-disorder-on-random-regular-graphs-October-5-2026/fixed-energy-universality-weak-anderson-disorder-random-regular-graphs.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 219 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b90d91abec2e8614), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are c, C > 0 and y0 < ∞ such that, for y = nη ≥ y0, P n W2(PH, Qζ) + W2(P0 H, Q0 ζ) > y−c o ≤ Cy−c . (20) Here W2 is transportation distance for the Euclidean metric on the disk. The estimate is uniform in e ∈ J and 0 < η ≤ h.
